parsed.post: Just doubled DEPTH from 4 to 8 and saw a significant drop in val_bpb from 1.1078 to 1.0357. Model capacity seems very impactful within this 5-minute budget. Moving onto testing larger scales for DEPTH and ASPECT_RATIO next.
parsed.description: Pushing capacity further by increasing DEPTH to 12 and ASPECT_RATIO to 64, while slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1 to compensate for the larger model.
